snippet.title: Single's Inferno: Choices | Official Game Trailer | Netflix
snippet.description:
Take a romantic beach walk, send a sweet note and... win a "chicken fight"? Do whatever it takes to get quality time with your crush in this story game.

Play Single's Inferno: Choices on your mobile devices. Available exclusively on Netflix: https://www.netflix.com/game/81746472

About Netflix:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.
